channel.title: Clerk incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Clerk's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Delayed email delivery to Microsoft (Outlook / Microsoft 365) recipients [resolved]
item.description: Delivery to Microsoft-hosted mailboxes has been normal since 12:40 UTC. All delayed emails were delivered. This incident is resolved.

item.title: GCP incident in us-central1-b [resolved]
item.description: Latency and error rates have held steady since the last update. We will re-open if there is a resurgence in errors or latency.

item.title: Elevated API latency [resolved]
item.description: API performance has remained stable following mitigation. This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Increased API latency and errors [resolved]
item.description: We've resolved the issue with our upstream provider.

item.title: Increased error rate [resolved]
item.description: All systems are operational

item.title: Elevated error rate in domain provisioning [resolved]
item.description: Custom domain provisioning is fully operational again

item.title: Elevated API Errors [resolved]
item.description: We have confirmed that error rates have returned to baseline.

item.title: Increased latency on our APIs [resolved]
item.description: There was a service degradation on our caching layer that affected the latency of our APIs. The caching layer is back to normal and latency dropped to normal levels.

item.title: Elevated errors while configuring domains [resolved]
item.description: All domains have been processed from this incident.

item.title: Elevated errors in Account Portal [resolved]
item.description: The underlying issue has been identified and the Account Portal is now fully functioning again.

item.title: Delay in webhook delivery [resolved]
item.description: We have identified the cause of the delays and our mitigations have been successful. We are continuing to monitor webhook delivery.

item.title: SVGs are not loading properly [resolved]
item.description: A fix has been published and confirmed it's now resolving SVGs correctly

item.title: Dashboard analytics not loading properly [resolved]
item.description: Services are up and running.

item.title: Elevated errors on Platform-API [resolved]
item.description: Systems are fully operational

item.title: Elevated errors or delays for Clerk application going live [resolved]
item.description: All systems are operational

item.title: Analytics API I/O timeouts [resolved]
item.description: Between 21:21 and 21:56 UTC on June 9, 2026, a portion of requests to our Analytics service failed and Dashboard charts may have failed to load. The cause was a database connection that had been silently closed upstream but was still being reused by our connection pool. We resolved the issue at 21:56 UTC. No data was lost. To prevent recurrence, we are rolling out a change to detect and self-heal from such failures. We apologize for the disruption

item.title: Elevated Errors in APIs [resolved]
item.description: APIs have returned to normal operation.

item.title: Elevated 500 rates on API responses [resolved]
item.description: The root cause has been identified and addressed. We will continue to monitor going forward.

item.title: Issue with Provisioning Domains [resolved]
item.description: Systems are back to normal.

item.title: SCIM services are facing intermittent errors [resolved]
item.description: The upstream provider marked the issue as resolved, we're continuing to monitor the database, but no error was observed.

item.title: Account Portal not Redirecting [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved.

item.title: Sign-in Clerk components unavailable for some domains [resolved]
item.description: We continue to work with our DNS provider to discover the source of the issue. We currently believe approximately 0.37% of traffic was impacted by being unable to resolve DNS of the CDN that provides ClerkJS.

item.title: Dashboard down [resolved]
item.description: We have identified the root cause and are putting in place mitigations to ensure this does not happen in the future.

item.title: Increased error rate [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved

item.title: /handshake endpoint failures [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved

item.title: Intermittent Issues with Development Services [resolved]
item.description: Development services are back to normal.
